headline: Denuncias contra Chávarry duermen en la Subcomisión de Acusaciones, presidida por el fujimorismo.
author: La Seño María
content: Desde que Pedro Chávarry asumió el cargo de fiscal de la Nación, el 20 de julio de 2018, se han presentado en el Congreso de la República cuatro denuncias constitucionales en su contra.

headline: Alista quinta denuncia contra el fiscal Chávarry en el Congreso
author: Ricardo Monzón Kosmatopoulos / Óscar Quispé
content: ¿Casualdad? Ninguna, al parecer. El miércoles último, el fiscal José Domingo Pérez solicitó a su superior, el fiscal Rafael Vela, coordinador del equipo especial del caso Lava Jato, que le enviase a Chávarry el requerimiento para que se le denunçiese, se inhibiese de la investigación y autorizase que el fiscal supremo más antiguo, en este caso Pablo Sánchez, profundizase las pesquisas en su contra.

headline: Mining could boost development in Apurimac
content: Proyecto Las Bambas would allow Apurimac to become a key economic driver over the next decade according to a study by the Center for Competitiveness and Development (CCD). Improvements in poverty reduction, nutrition rates, literacy comprehension, and mathematical reasoning indicate significant progress.

headline: The workers who earn up to S/3,062 monthly will not pay income tax
author: Sunat information
content: The government stated through SUNAT that employees earning fourth-category incomes up to S/3,062 monthly won't have to pay Income Tax during 2019. Those exceeding this amount may still qualify for exemptions depending on their annual projected earnings.

headline: Agricultural Bank Law strengthens support for small producers
subheadline: President promotes law aimed at aiding agricultural growth
author: Congress approval noted
content: With President Martin Vizcarra's endorsement, legislation was passed aiming to strengthen Agrarian Banking services directed towards smaller agricultural enterprises, including creating funding pools worth millions.

headline: Eduardo Cesti reflects on his acting career and life challenges
subheadline: Interview highlights resilience despite health issues
author: Mihaill Palacioz Yabar interview
content: In conversation about his illustrious yet challenging career, Eduardo Cesti discusses overcoming vision loss due to diabetes complications while expressing gratitude for recent pension approvals allowing him some financial relief amidst mobility difficulties caused by losing a limb.

headline: Crimen impactante en Moquegua.
author: NA
content: Sonia fue encontrada agonizando sobre un charco de sangre, el objeto con el que fue atacada estaba a su costado impregnado de sangre.
